description: This header file declares functions, macros, and external references related to HTTP proxy support within the cURL project. It defines the interface for managing HTTP proxy operations such as destination retrieval, connection creation, and proxy host configuration.

methods.name: Curl_http_proxy_get_destination
methods.description: Retrieves the destination hostname and port for the specified proxy filter.

methods.name: Curl_http_proxy_create_CONNECT
methods.description: Creates an HTTP CONNECT request for establishing a proxy tunnel.

methods.name: Curl_cf_http_proxy_get_host
methods.description: Gets the proxy host and display host for a given proxy filter.

methods.name: Curl_cf_http_proxy_insert_after
methods.description: Inserts an HTTP proxy filter after a specified filter in the filter chain.
